scenario: Comparison chains per LEXP.2.1 — a < b < c desugars to (a < b) and (b < c). rule_in fires when v is strictly between 1 and 10; rule_out does not fire for v=15.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule rule_in:
    T t where 1 < t.v < 10
->
    log critical "in"

rule rule_out:
    T t where 10 < t.v < 5
->
    log critical "out"
